Continuous-Time Generative Models: A Survey
Grace Lee
arXiv, 2026
Abstract: A survey of continuous-time generative models, comparing flow matching,
diffusion and drifting across training and inference costs.
Continuous-time models trade training complexity for sampling efficiency.
We compare flow matching, diffusion and training-time drifting.
References
[1] Smith, A., Jones, B. (2026). Flow Matching for Language Generation. Journal of
Synthetic Tests. https://doi.org/10.1234/flowlm.2026
[2] White, C., Brown, D. (2026). Training-Time Drift for Generative Modeling.
arXiv:2601.01234.
[3] Green, E., Black, F. (2025). Discrete Diffusion Language Models. NeurIPS 2025.
